name: Itsu made mo Mama to Issho! ~Yuuwaku Mama no Oppai ni Amaete Ippai Shasei Shitai!~
original_name: いつまでもママといっしょ！～誘惑ママのおっぱいに甘えていっぱい射精したい！～
source: The protagonist, Kanzaki Takumi, has a worry. It's about his relationship with his recently remarried father's new spouse. He struggles with how to interact with her and feels awkward. However, with advice from his own mother, Misaki, he gradually deepens his bond with his new family. On the other hand, Misaki, despite her son's worries being resolved, feels a sense of loneliness. Even though things should be going well, she can't help but feel anxious and jealous, fearing that her son might be taken away from her. She knows such feelings are not appropriate as a mother, but she can't bear to let go of her son...
translation: 主人公神崎匡有一个烦恼，那就是与父亲再婚后的新妻子，该如何相处。他不知怎样与她互动，总觉得尴尬。然而，在亲生母亲实咲的建议下，他逐渐与新家人加深感情。另一方面，尽管儿子的烦恼已经解决，实咲却感到一阵孤独。明明一切都该顺利，她却忍不住焦虑、嫉妒，害怕儿子被人夺走。她明知，身为母亲，不该有这样的感受，却仍无法忍受放开儿子…
